faqs.question: How do we choose the right pixel pitch for an LED wall?
faqs.answer: Pixel pitch depends mainly on viewing distance, resolution expectation, content type and budget. GPSPL studies these factors before recommending indoor, outdoor, fine-pitch or other LED options.

faqs.question: Does GPSPL supply LED products or only install them?
faqs.answer: GPSPL is distribution-first. We can supply LED cabinets, controllers, processors, mounts and related accessories, and also provide design, installation, commissioning, AMC and support.

faqs.question: Can GPSPL support indoor and outdoor LED walls?
faqs.answer: Yes. GPSPL can support indoor and outdoor LED display requirements, including brightness planning, structure, power, cabling, controller workflow, installation and maintenance.

faqs.question: What information is needed for an LED wall quote?
faqs.answer: Useful details include wall size, viewing distance, indoor or outdoor use, content type, operating hours, site photos, power availability, mounting surface and support expectations.

faqs.question: Does GPSPL handle mounting and structure planning?
faqs.answer: Yes. GPSPL coordinates mounting, cabinet alignment, wall structure planning, cable routing, power, ventilation and safe access for maintenance.

faqs.question: Can LED walls connect with AV switching and control systems?
faqs.answer: Yes. LED walls can be integrated with source switching, processors, matrix routing, presentation systems, control panels and digital signage workflows.

faqs.question: Does GPSPL provide AMC for active LED walls?
faqs.answer: Yes. GPSPL can provide preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, warranty coordination, calibration support, spare planning and post-installation technical support.
